title: fix(components,react): page element loading, empty and error defaults read the bundle (objectui#12889)
body:
Fixes #12889
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Page element blocks now draw their loading, empty and error defaults in the page's language. All three files read copy through `useObjectTranslation` from `@object-ui/i18n`. `elements.tsx` already used this hook (`element.number.noObject`), and so did `ElementDataSourceGate.tsx` (`view.malformedFilter`, `view.noObject`). Each inline `defaultValue` is the `en` pack's value, and `check:i18n-keys` keeps the two byte-identical.

| Site | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `element:repeater` loading | `Loading…` literal | `common.loading` (zh: 加载中…), `role="status"` |
| `element:repeater` empty | `'No records'` | `common.noData` (en: "No data", zh: 暂无数据). An authored `emptyText` still wins |
| `element:repeater` error, no message | `'Failed to load'` | `list.loadErrorTitle` (en: "Couldn’t load records", zh: 无法加载记录). A thrown message is still shown as thrown |
| `element:number` loading | a bare `…` glyph at text-3xl | the `Skeleton` primitive (`h-9 w-20`, the number's line height), `role="status"`, `aria-label` = `common.loading` |
| `ElementDataSourceLoadingPanel` | `Loading view…` | `common.loading` |

- **Keys.** All four keys already existed in every pack, so no language-pack key, prop, widget or export was added.
- **No-message rejections.** A rejection with an empty message used to fall through `if (error)` to the empty state. It now shows the error default.
- **English copy changes.** The repeater's English empty text is now "No data" instead of "No records", and the saved-view placeholder now reads "Loading…" instead of "Loading view…". The three existing assertions on `'No records'` (`data-list.contractEnvelope-6726`, `data-list.elementDataSource-11880` ×2) were updated to match. One code comment in `element-number.contractEnvelope-6726` that described the old glyph was updated too.

## Pins (beside the renderers)

- `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/__tests__/element-loading-copy-12889.test.tsx`
  - **Repeater under zh-CN:** a pending find shows 加载中… and no Latin letters, an empty answer shows 暂无数据, and a rejection with no message shows 无法加载记录.
  - **Repeater controls:** a thrown message is shown as thrown, an authored `emptyText` wins, and under en the defaults read "Loading…" and "No data".
  - **Number:** while loading it draws the skeleton (`animate-pulse`, `role=status`, `aria-label` 加载中…), with no `…` and no `.tabular-nums`. Control: once the aggregate answers, the number replaces the skeleton.
- `packages/react/src/element-data-source/__tests__/ElementDataSourceLoadingPanel.i18n-12889.test.tsx`
  - The gate, pending on a named view under zh-CN, draws 加载中… and no English.
  - Control: under en the panel draws "Loading…".
  - Without a provider it draws the inline default, not the raw key.

**Ablation.** I put the repeater's literal back (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` from the objectstack checkout). The run is wrapped and its restore is proven:
```
ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob fe0a34049038 -> bb1a25003189
 FAIL ... > under zh-CN, a pending find shows the zh loading text and no English
AssertionError: expected 'Loading…' to be '加载中…'
      Tests  1 failed | 7 passed (8)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (fe0a34049038) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```
The first attempt was a no-op. The tool refused it before any test ran, because the replacement text `Loading…` already appeared inside the anchor, so its count could not rise. I re-ran it with the distinct spelling shown above.

## Verification (head `74a80e8e2f`)

- **Closure build:** `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/components^...' run build`, exit 0 (8 of 47 projects).
- **Type-check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components --filter @object-ui/react run type-check` (both run `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, which includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`), exit 0.
- **Targeted vitest:** the 2 new and 3 edited test files, 33/33 passed.
- **`packages/react/` (whole dir):** 114 files and 1429 tests passed.
- **`packages/components/` (whole dir): NOT MEASURED** — 405 test files, more than the container's foreground limit allows under a shared lock. I narrowed the run to every test file in `renderers/basic/` plus every test file in the repo that names `element:repeater`, `'repeater'`, `element:number`, `data-list`, `ElementDataSourceLoadingPanel`, `resolving-view` or `Loading view`. That set was 84 files and 3552 tests, and all passed. The full-dir run is left to CI.
- **Lint:** `eslint --no-inline-config` over the 8 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files gave 0 errors. The warnings are all on lines that predate this change. The config sets no `parserOptions.project` and no `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.
- **Battery, all exit 0:** `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `i18n-dead-keys`, `control-bytes`, `scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` and `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`.

## Acceptance notes

These are the same family, but outside this card's ruling, so I did not change them. `record-picker.tsx` is also outside the claimed file surface:
- **`element:record_picker` (`record-picker.tsx`):** the empty default is `'No records'`, and the input placeholder is `'Loading…'` or `'Failed to load'`. All are English literals. The existing pin "keeps the No records default for an ABSENT key" renders that English under zh-CN.
- **`element:number` (`elements.tsx`):** the error fallback is `'aggregate failed'`, and the error-panel title is "This metric’s data source could not be resolved". Both are English literals.
- **`element:definition-list` (`data-list.tsx`):** the empty state is a `No details` literal.
